post.summary: Screen equities based on complex criteria
post.description:
Screen for stocks and other financial instruments based on complex filtering criteria.
    
    ## Supported Operators:
    - **eq**: equals
    - **ne**: not equals
    - **gt**: greater than
    - **lt**: less than
    - **gte**: greater than or equal to
    - **lte**: less than or equal to
    - **contains**: string contains
    - **is-in**: value is in a list
    - **starts-with**: string starts with
    - **ends-with**: string ends with
    - **and**: logical AND (combine multiple conditions)
    - **or**: logical OR (combine multiple conditions)
    
    ## Common Filter Fields:
    
    ### Region:
    ar, at, au, be, br, ca, ch, cl, cn, co, cz, de, dk, ee, eg, es, fi, fr, gb, gr, hk, hu, id, ie, il, in, is, it, jp, kr, kw, lk, lt, lv, mx, my, nl, no, nz, pe, ph, pk, pl, pt, qa, ro, ru, sa, se, sg, sr, sw, th, tr, tw, us, ve, vn, za
    
    ### Exchange (by region):
    - **US**: ASE, BTS, CXI, NCM, NGM, NMS, NYQ, OEM, OQB, OQX, PCX, PNK, YHD
    - **CA**: CNQ, NEO, TOR, VAN
    - **GB**: AQS, IOB, LSE
    - **DE**: BER, DUS, FRA, GER, HAM, MUN, STU
    - **JP**: FKA, JPX, SAP
    - **CN**: SHH, SHZ
    - **HK**: HKG
    - **AU**: ASX
    - **IN**: BSE, NSI
    - **KR**: KOE, KSC
    - **TW**: TAI, TWO
    - And many more...
    
    ### Sector:
    - Basic Materials
    - Communication Services
    - Consumer Cyclical
    - Consumer Defensive
    - Energy
    - Financial Services
    - Healthcare
    - Industrials
    - Real Estate
    - Technology
    - Utilities
    
    ### Industry (examples by sector):
    - **Basic Materials**: Agricultural Inputs, Aluminum, Chemicals, Copper, Gold, Steel
    - **Technology**: Software Application, Semiconductors, Computer Hardware, Consumer Electronics
    - **Healthcare**: Biotechnology, Drug Manufacturers, Medical Devices, Pharmaceutical Retailers
    - **Financial Services**: Banks Regional, Asset Management, Insurance, Capital Markets
    - **Energy**: Oil Gas E P, Oil Gas Refining Marketing, Solar
    - And many more...
    
    ### Financial Metrics:
    - **epsgrowth.lasttwelvemonths**: EPS growth (trailing 12 months)
    - **intradaymarketcap**: Market capitalization
    - **peratio.lasttwelvemonths**: P/E ratio (TTM)
    - **pricebookratio.quarterly**: Price-to-book ratio
    - **returnonequity.lasttwelvemonths**: ROE (TTM)
    - **totalrevenues.lasttwelvemonths**: Total revenues (TTM)
    - **avgdailyvol3m**: Average daily volume (3 months)
    - **beta**: Stock beta
    
    ## Example Query:
    ```json
    {
      "operator": "and",
      "conditions": [
        {"operator": "is-in", "field": "exchange", "value": ["NMS", "NYQ"]},
        {"operator": "eq", "field": "sector", "value": "Technology"},
        {"operator": "lt", "field": "epsgrowth.lasttwelvemonths", "value": 15},
        {"operator": "gt", "field": "intradaymarketcap", "value": 1000000000}
      ]
    }
    ```

get.description:
Use Yahoo Finance's predefined screeners to find stocks.
    
    Available screeners:
    - **aggressive_small_caps**: Small cap stocks with high growth potential
    - **day_gainers**: Stocks with the highest percentage gains today
    - **day_losers**: Stocks with the highest percentage losses today
    - **growth_technology_stocks**: Technology stocks with strong growth metrics
    - **most_actives**: Most actively traded stocks by volume
    - **most_shorted_stocks**: Stocks with the highest short interest
    - **small_cap_gainers**: Small cap stocks with recent gains
    - **undervalued_growth_stocks**: Growth stocks trading below their intrinsic value
    - **undervalued_large_caps**: Large cap stocks trading below their intrinsic value
    - **conservative_foreign_funds**: Conservative international mutual funds
    - **high_yield_bond**: High yield bond funds
    - **portfolio_anchors**: Stable, dividend-paying stocks
    - **solid_large_growth_funds**: Large cap growth mutual funds
    - **solid_midcap_growth_funds**: Mid cap growth mutual funds
    - **top_mutual_funds**: Top performing mutual funds
Search for stocks, ETFs, and other financial instruments by name, ISIN, or ticker symbol

get.description: Last 5 annual or 8 quarterly periods (oldest first). Amounts are in the statement `currency`; margins are decimals. Educational information, not financial advice.
Cash runway, dilution, leverage, interest coverage, Altman Z and Piotroski F, each with a status. Educational information, not financial advice.
Normalised valuation, growth, margins, health and 1/3/5y price returns (decimals). Educational information, not financial advice.
SMA 20/50/200, EMA 12/26, RSI 14, MACD (12,26,9), Bollinger (20,2), average volume and simple support/resistance. Educational information, not financial advice.

cagr.title: Cagr
cagr.description: Time-weighted annualised return: daily returns chained excluding external cash flows, annualised over calendar days (365.25). Not money-weighted.

max_drawdown.title: Max Drawdown
max_drawdown.description: Most negative peak-to-trough fraction of the time-weighted return index (unaffected by contributions)

volatility_annual.title: Volatility Annual
volatility_annual.description: Std of daily time-weighted returns * sqrt(252)

time_in_market.title: Time In Market
time_in_market.description: Fraction of days with a non-zero invested position

monthly_amount.title: Monthly Amount
monthly_amount.description: dca: amount invested on the first trading day of each month

rsi_buy.title: Rsi Buy
rsi_buy.description: rsi: buy when RSI(14) crosses below this level

rsi_sell.title: Rsi Sell
rsi_sell.description: rsi: sell when RSI(14) crosses above this level

fee_bps.title: Fee Bps
fee_bps.description: Fee per trade in basis points of traded notional

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Relative weight; weights are normalised to sum to 1

limit_per_ticker.title: Limit Per Ticker
limit_per_ticker.description: Maximum number of news items per ticker

days.title: Days
days.description: Number of days to look back for news

invested.title: Invested

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of instruments in this page

NewsArticle.title: NewsArticle
NewsArticle.description: Schema for news articles related to stocks

risk_free_rate.title: Risk Free Rate
risk_free_rate.description: Annual risk-free rate as a decimal (0.03 = 3%)

valuation_date.title: Valuation Date
valuation_date.description: Common last date used for prices, weights and total_value

benchmark_currency.title: Benchmark Currency
benchmark_currency.description: Currency the benchmark was converted from (null if unknown)

price.title: Price
price.description: Close on valuation_date, in the asset's quoted currency/unit (pence for GBp)

fx_rate.title: Fx Rate
fx_rate.description: Base currency per quoted unit; price * quantity * fx_rate == value_base

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency the price is denominated in, e.g. USD, EUR

return.title: Return
return.description: Position return in the scenario (decimal, base currency)

beta.title: Beta
beta.description: Beta (clamped to [0, 3]) used for beta_proxy/shock; null for 'historical' positions. Estimated from weekly (W-FRI) base-currency returns vs ^GSPC over the last 2y (>= 52 weekly observations), else 1.0

method.title: Method
method.description: 'historical' if every position has its own data; 'beta_proxy' if any position used beta x benchmark; 'shock' for market shocks

TickerNews.title: TickerNews
TickerNews.description: Schema for news related to a specific ticker

monthly_contribution.title: Monthly Contribution
monthly_contribution.description: Contribution of the modified portfolio (defaults to the current one)

p50_return.title: P50 Return
p50_return.description: Modified minus current of (final p50 / (start_value + total_contributions) - 1)

p5_return.title: P5 Return
p5_return.description: Modified minus current of (final p5 / (start_value + total_contributions) - 1)

cash_from_sales.title: Cash From Sales
cash_from_sales.description: Proceeds of the sells (qty x last price, base currency). Kept as cash with 0 return in the modified portfolio (included in its start_value); buys are funded by new money
